problem: Heroku said fraud and abuse of free plans consumed large engineering and security effort.
title: Heroku ends its free product plans
context: Heroku offered free dynos, free Postgres and free Redis plans.
decision_made: Stop offering free product plans from 28 November 2022.
action_taken: Announced in August 2022, began deleting inactive accounts in October, and introduced new low-cost plans.
observed_outcome: The free plans ended as scheduled on 28 November 2022. Effects on usage and revenue were not found.
lessons: A free tier can attract abuse; removing it moves costs to users who may leave for alternatives.
limitations: Reasons are the company's own. No usage or revenue figures were found.

claims.claim_text: Heroku announced it would stop offering free product plans starting 28 November 2022.
As of 28 November 2022 free dynos and hobby-dev data plans were no longer available.
